entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely terrible shoes I bought from you. This is a complete joke.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. Could I start with your name and order number?
The name is Mike Peterson, order 774-29B. Look, I don't have time for a runaround. I bought these cycling shoes about a month ago, and they are unusable.

Okay, Mike, I have your order right here. I see the Spin Class Shoes purchased on December 8th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A fault? They're defective! They're giving me horrible blisters on my heels. I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, and it doesn't matter. They're just poorly made. I want a refund, and I want it now.
I certainly understand your frustration. Getting blisters is the last thing you want when you're trying to get a workout in. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for this item.

Don't you dare read me some policy! I paid for a premium product and got junk. If you don't process this, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. Get me your manager!

That won't be necessary, Mike, I can definitely resolve this for you. I've just confirmed the policy. Since your purchase was 36 days ago, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window for these shoes.
So you're actually going to do it? You're going to give me my money back?

Yes, absolutely. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label and I'll email it to you in the next few minutes. Just pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and drop it off.
Okay. A full refund, no fees or any of that garbage?
That's correct, a full refund to your original payment method. You'll see the credit appear 3-5 business days after the item is received back at our warehouse.
Fine. That's all I wanted. Should have been that easy from the start. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mike. I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
